mode.title: Mode
mode.description: hashtag = the ranked Shorts grid for each hashtag. video = figures for Shorts you already have IDs for. reference = probe both surfaces and report what they yielded.

hashtags.title: Hashtags (mode: hashtag)
hashtags.description: With or without the leading #. Full /hashtag/ URLs also work.

videos.title: Shorts (mode: video)
videos.description: Video IDs, /shorts/ links or watch URLs.

shortsPerHashtag.title: Shorts per hashtag
shortsPerHashtag.description: Capped at 36 because that is what one grid page lists. The grid exposes a single continuation token which this Actor does not follow - see the README.

detail.title: Fetch per-Short figures
detail.description: On: one extra request per Short, giving exact views, likes, the like-to-view ratio, duration and sound. Off: grid only, which means ROUNDED views ("3.3 million") and no likes at all.

exactLikes.title: Exact like counts
exactLikes.description: The /shorts/ page rounds likes to "36 thousand"; the watch page gives 36,212. Turning this on switches surface. It costs a second request per Short only when you also want the sound attribution, which the watch page does not carry.

tlsProfile.title: Preferred TLS profile
tlsProfile.description: Optional. The hashtag grid answered identically on all four during recon; this is a tuning knob.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Useful if Shorts pages start coming back as REDUCED.
